categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Fudan-Zhangjiang Bio-Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. primarily operates in innovative biopharmaceutical research and development, manufacturing, and marketing. Its main product lines include photodynamic therapy drugs for skin diseases and tumors, antibody-drug conjugates (ADC) for cancer treatment, and nanomedicine formulations. Key marketed products are photodynamic drugs for HPV-related diseases (Aila®), tumor treatment liposomal doxorubicin (Libao Duo®), and photodynamic drugs for port-wine stains (Fumeida®).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced core technologies including photodynamic therapy platforms, gene engineering, nanotechnology (notably liposomal drug delivery), and oral solid formulation platforms. It focuses on proprietary photodynamic drugs, antibody-drug conjugates (ADC), and nanomedicines with targeted delivery and reduced toxicity. Manufacturing adheres to cGMP standards with strict quality control and validated production processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are hospitals, clinics, and healthcare providers specializing in dermatology, oncology, and related medical fields within China. The company’s products serve patients with HPV infections, skin proliferative diseases, tumors, and other targeted indications. Sales are mainly domestic, with ongoing efforts to expand internationally, especially in the US and Europe.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations and sales are predominantly in mainland China, with a registered office and production facilities in Shanghai and Taizhou. It also maintains a business presence in Hong Kong. International clinical trials and regulatory filings are underway to facilitate future overseas market entry, particularly in the United States.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Fudan-Zhangjiang operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the biopharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on drug R&D, manufacturing, and marketing. It produces finished pharmaceutical products and supplies them to healthcare institutions and distributors. The company also manages procurement of raw materials and contract manufacturing inputs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic R&D focus is on photodynamic therapy drugs, antibody-drug conjugates (ADC), and nanomedicines. It prioritizes innovation in skin diseases, tumor visualization and treatment, and expanding indications for existing drugs. Significant investment is made in clinical trials, including Phase II and III studies, and in building production capacity for ADCs. The company aims to strengthen its global competitiveness through international registrations and new drug development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of pharmaceutical products, including photodynamic drugs, anticancer nanomedicines, and other specialty pharmaceuticals. The company employs a distribution model involving direct sales and partnerships with contract sales organizations (CSOs) for academic promotion. It also derives income from technology licensing and service fees related to drug development.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading innovator in photodynamic therapy and ADC drug development within China, holding a strong market share in these niche areas. It competes with domestic and international pharmaceutical firms in oncology and dermatology drug markets. Its unique focus on photodynamic drugs and ADCs differentiates it from peers, with a competitive edge in proprietary technology platforms and clinical pipeline.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 709 million, a 16.6% decrease from the previous year, primarily due to transitional sales challenges. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 39.7 million, down 63.4% year-over-year, impacted by increased R&D expenses. The company maintains total assets of about RMB 2.59 billion and net assets of RMB 2.3 billion. R&D investment accounted for 44.3% of revenue, reflecting a strong growth and innovation focus despite short-term profit pressure.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Fudan-Zhangjiang emphasizes its pioneering photodynamic therapy drugs as first-in-class treatments addressing unmet clinical needs, such as HPV-related diseases and port-wine stains, with superior safety and efficacy profiles. Its liposomal doxorubicin offers enhanced tumor targeting and reduced toxicity compared to traditional chemotherapy. The company’s ADC pipeline targets difficult-to-treat cancers with innovative linker-drug technologies, aiming to provide highly effective and precise therapies. Its integrated R&D and manufacturing capabilities underpin its commitment to delivering differentiated, clinically valuable biopharmaceutical products.
